gloss: first match; opening game; first battle

definitions.gloss: first match; opening game; first round
definitions.explanation: The first game or match in a tournament, series, or competition. Also refers to the first battle in a war or military campaign.

examples.japanese: {初戦|しょせん}は{来週|らいしゅう}の{月曜日|げつようび}だ。
examples.english: The first match is next Monday.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}チームは{初戦|しょせん}を{白星|しろぼし}で{飾|かざ}った。
examples.english: The Japanese team celebrated their opening game with a win.

examples.japanese: {初戦|しょせん}で{強豪|きょうごう}チームに{当|あ}たってしまったが、{善戦|ぜんせん}した。
examples.english: We were matched against a powerhouse team in the first round, but we put up a good fight.

notes:
Compound of {初|しょ} (first) + {戦|せん} (match, battle). Used primarily in sports and competition contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {初戦|しょせん}を{飾|かざ}る: to win the opening match
- {初戦|しょせん}で{敗退|はいたい}する: to be eliminated in the first round
- {初戦|しょせん}に{勝|か}つ: to win the first match
- {初戦|しょせん}の{相手|あいて}: first-round opponent

NOTE ON HOMOPHONES:
Do not confuse with {所詮|しょせん} (after all, in the end), which is pronounced the same but has a completely different meaning.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {第一戦|だいいっせん}: first match (in a series) — can refer to game one of a multi-game series
- {開幕戦|かいまくせん}: opening game (of a season) — specifically the season opener
